name: weight the two neighbouring samples by position along the segment
mechanism: find the two samples that bracket the query, and return the value that lies the same fraction of the way between them as the query lies between their positions

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Linear interpolation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation: a method of curve fitting using linear polynomials
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bilinear interpolation': an extension of linear interpolation for interpolating functions of two variables on a regular grid

fails_when: kinks at every sample; error grows with curvature
